Costs and Fees
Costs and Fees
There are many costs to keep in mind when planning your graduate studies at the University of Arizona such as tuition, books, and cost of living. Here you can find information on the following:
Graduate Admission Application Fee
Financial Guarantee Requirement for Incoming International Students
Graduate Student Tuition and Fees Chart
Please keep in mind that there are also many resources of financial support for graduate students.
Estimated Costs of a University of Arizona Education
Estimated Cost of Attendance - from the Office of Student Financial Aid
Tuition and Fees overview - from the Bursar's Office
Official University of Arizona Tuition Calculator - from the Bursar's Office
Residency Classification: In-State vs. Non-Resident Classification - from the Registrar's Office
Differential Tuition for Dual Degrees
The Graduate College does not control or charge tuition or differential fees. For questions regarding tuition or differential fees please contact the Bursar's Office.
Late Charges
Please refer to the Bursar's Office for information about late charges.
Guaranteed Mandatory Fees
Guaranteed Mandatory Fees were discontinued in Spring 2024. Please refer to the Bursar's Office for any questions regarding fees.
